accepts.because: a manifest somebody drafted and now wants applied, under their own identity. The identity is NOT promoted by the edge and must not be: it is `envelope.reply_to`, stamped by the substrate on the emission itself. A context key would be a claim, and a claim is not an identity

the broker's answer to the ONE question this hive asks per submission. It is a separate lane rather than a reply on the asking one because the shell has to re-stamp it: `access` answers on `grant`, and `grant` at this level is the broker's rim lane for everybody else

emits.because: the manifest, checked and attributed, on its way to the mutation door. This is the ONLY lane in the whole tree that reaches that door, which is why it is the only audit trail there is -- `/colony/mutations` cannot be drawn by any mutation on any scope, so the edge that carries this lane lives in the birth topology and nowhere else

what happened, for whoever asked: how many declarations committed, at which position it stopped, and with which code. A refusal travels here too -- a submission that was not made is a fact its requester has to be told, not a silence

may this identity have a manifest applied under this scope root -- asked ONCE per submission, in the check-only form, of whatever the composition wired as its broker. The cell decides nothing itself: a policy inside the ONE cell with an edge onto the mutation door is an audit trail that cannot say who decided

required_drains.because: a caller that hands this hive a manifest and does not take the receipt back has asked for a change to the colony and arranged to never learn whether it happened. A manifest rolls forward with no rollback, so 'I do not know' is the one answer that cannot be recovered from. The two edges are one decision

a composition that wires the question and not the answer has arranged for every submission to hang parked forever, under a digest nobody will ever quote again. The pair is one decision, and the instantiation refuses half of it rather than running silently un-policed

description.purpose: The submission gate: two occupants behind one door, and the only reach onto the mutation door in the whole tree. It asks who may submit; it does not answer it.
description.use_when: At the OS level, beside the builder that drafts -- and never inside it. The guardrail of R6 is a MISSING EDGE, and a missing edge can only be missing between two nodes.
description.not_in_scope: No drafting, no composing, no model, no disk, no network.
